status: PLANNED, critic-hardened 2026-09-22 (18 findings: 0 BLOCKER, 5 MAJOR, 8 MINOR, 5 NIT — all folded into PLAN.md, record in §8). Six owner decisions (Q1–Q4 before the plan, Q5–Q6 after the critic). No code.

decisions.Q1: sandbox = 1 by default (e, s///e, r, R, w, W refused by sed); sandbox = 0 opts out
decisions.Q2: both var expr and proc addExpr/clearExprs over ${inst}_exprs; plus var scriptFile (-f)
decisions.Q3: 0->0; 1,2,4 -> 1 + debug; 127 base; any other (q/Q status) -> 1 silent, raw in lastRc
decisions.Q4: inPlace + backupSuffix; run only; the five sinks overridden and rc 2 with inPlace = 1
decisions.Q5: inPlace = 1 and nullData = 1 derive -b in buildArgv (text mode rewrites CRLF to LF on disk, even the identity, and strips a CR inside a NUL record); the binary property is never written
decisions.Q6: deny-list in buildArgv for extras that duplicate a typed property or break the stream: -i/--in-place, -z/--null-data, -e/--expression, -f/--file, -n/--quiet/--silent, -s/--separate, -E/-r/--regexp-extended, -b/--binary, --sandbox, and bundled short words containing i z e f n s E r b; --posix, -u, -l N, --follow-symlinks, --debug pass

execution_log.summary: Opus critic, 9 probe scripts and a prototype on the real tutil, both bashes byte-identical (5.2.37 resolves Git for Windows' sed, 5.3.9 msys64's; both 4.9). No blockers. MAJORS: (1) in-place in text mode rewrites CRLF to LF on disk, even the identity -> owner Q5: inPlace and nullData derive -b; (2) addArg -i / -ni / -z / --expression / -f bypass the typed properties (a sink edits or truncates the file with rc 0, loses records, reorders the script) -> owner Q6: deny-list; (3) ${inst}_exprs is fillable as an out-name, so records become the next run's script -> TUTIL_OUT_SUFFIXES registry with the two guards, tsed appends _exprs; (4) TSed.edit '' could not be the identity -> edit uses addExpr; (5) the missing-file pin was wrong for each (a proc, rc 1, RESULT untouched) and first (rc 0 + record + lastRc 2, the consumer-stop contract) -> restated. MINOR/NIT: rc 4 stops processing at the operand (not partial like rc 2), a missing -f script is rc 4; the backupSuffix rule targeted harmless characters — `*` alone (no backup, silently) is now rc 2, `*` and `/` documented; a script's q1/q2/q4 looks like a sed error (debug wording says so) and -i + q/Q/-n truncates silently (README trap); sandbox also refuses s///w incl. /dev/stdout and does not guard -i; --debug prints to stdout (sinks refused); a callback's bare assignment writes the instance's properties (bare sandbox=0 disarms the default — README trap); tutil/docs/TUtil.md §4 stale tsed row; #n and a\ across chunks; -i on -; two sed binaries; S5/S9 fixture details; -i implies -s. Verified: the proc each override keeps rc, frame, __TPIPE_QUIET, D6, this, no per-record cost; the refusal leaves _lastRc -1 and the file intact; the sandbox is compile-time and total.

Owner: start tsed. GNU sed 4.9 measured under both bashes (byte-identical): each -e is compiled when read, so every option must precede the first -e (`-e 's/(/X/' -E` silently runs as BRE); `sed FILE` takes FILE as the script; rc 1 bad script, 2 missing input (partial output kept), 4 I/O, q/Q N any status; text mode strips CR, -b keeps it; -z NUL records; one stream across files unless -s; -i writes nothing to stdout, suffix attached; e/s///e/r/w/W execute or touch files, --sandbox refuses them. Owner decided four questions before the plan: sandbox on by default; both expr and addExpr; rc 1/2/4 with debug, q/Q status silent; inPlace + backupSuffix with run only. PLAN.md + this ledger written. No code.
